item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text: {"rule":"After each tap, the procedure announced whether the tapped cards would remain or be discarded; the final card was the survivor after applying those announcements. Because these retain/discard decisions varied even for the same choices, the observations are insufficient to infer what determined them."}
